edges.root_basis:
NO EDGE IS DRAWN TO GRATIAN, and the omission is the finding rather than a gap.
The bull addresses the doctors and scholars of Bologna and orders that no other
collection be made without special authority of the Apostolic See; it does not
say what it follows. That the Liber Extra stands on the Decretum is true and is
a scholarly claim, and this record carries scholarly claims with their sources
or not at all.
